proposal.expected_outcome: A sticky nav reaches every section. Its script wraps its own code in try/catch and hides any nav link whose target is missing, so no JS error or dead in-page link can occur.
proposal.completion_check: The nav has 4 links, and each href resolves to an existing element id. Each nav link is at least 44px tall at 360px. There are no JS errors and no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px. The filters and category parts of item 7 are out of scope per the Requester's drop.
